metadata.title: Synthetic household-month and dated-payment fixtures
metadata.creator: Economics & Finance Mastery Library
metadata.provenance: Original teaching data, constructed for this chapter; no real households, transactions or empirical estimates.
metadata.reuse: May be reused and modified with this library's exercises; no third-party data access is required.
metadata.population: Four fictional roster households A-D; the observation table contains reported household-months, not a complete panel.
metadata.units: income_cents and amount_cents are integer cents of one fictional dollar currency; 100 cents = 1 dollar. No inflation or currency conversion is implied.
metadata.weights: Positive integer demonstration weights, not estimated survey weights; use only observed incomes in the complete-case weighted denominator.
metadata.dates: month is the first calendar day YYYY-MM-01 representing that whole month; event times include numeric UTC offsets and have second resolution.
metadata.missingness: JSON null denotes unreported income, zero denotes recorded zero income, and no observation row denotes absence of a report.
metadata.raw_roster: Contains an intentional exact duplicate of A for diagnosing multiplicative joins; it is never substituted silently for the canonical roster.
